categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in real estate development including residential buildings, hotels, industrial plants, and commercial office buildings for lease and sale. It also operates in interior design and construction, real estate brokerage services, and hotel and restaurant management. Recently, the company has expanded its hotel operations in New Taipei, Taichung, and Tainan to generate stable non-core income.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes careful architectural design tailored to location, environment, and consumer lifestyle, employing optimal construction methods and strict project management to enhance quality and control costs. It integrates smart building technologies such as IoT and energy-efficient materials to meet modern living standards and sustainability goals. Construction is primarily subcontracted to its invested construction company to ensure quality and schedule control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers are mainly individual homebuyers, investors, and commercial tenants in Taiwan's residential, industrial, and commercial real estate markets. The hotel segment serves domestic and international business travelers and tourists. The company targets metropolitan areas with high demand, including Taipei, New Taipei, and Tainan, focusing on first-time buyers and self-use purchasers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, particularly in the Greater Taipei area (Taipei City and New Taipei City), Taichung, and Tainan. The company also participates in urban renewal projects in key city districts and manages hotels in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land development, property construction, sales, leasing, and property management. It vertically integrates by investing in a construction company to control building quality and progress.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include urban renewal and redevelopment projects, development of mixed-use commercial hotels, and smart, energy-efficient building designs aligned with Taiwan's net-zero carbon goals. The company actively monitors government policies and market trends to adjust development strategies and enhance product competitiveness. It also invests in employee training and information security management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales and leasing of residential, commercial, and industrial properties. Additional income streams include hotel operations and management fees. The company also earns investment income from subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in Taiwan's highly competitive real estate development sector, with a focus on quality, location, and product differentiation. It maintains a relatively low debt ratio and strong financial position compared to peers, leveraging stable land acquisition and diversified product offerings to sustain market competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$2.24 billion, a 40.6% decrease from the previous year, and net profit of NT$423 million, down 52.45%. Total assets were about NT$11.93 billion with equity of NT$9.7 billion. Despite recent revenue declines due to market cooling and regulatory constraints, the company maintains stable financial health and plans steady growth through strategic land development and diversified operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, quality, and customer service, delivering safe, stable, and human-centric real estate products with advanced technology integration. It differentiates through smart building designs, strict construction management, comprehensive after-sales service, and sustainable development aligned with environmental policies. Its hotel operations focus on enhancing guest experience with location advantages and technology adoption.
